title: God Does Not Play Dice: Enforcing Batch Invariance in Agentic Kernel Generation
title_zh: 上帝不掷骰子：在智能体化内核生成中强制批处理不变性

paragraphs.en: 提出批处理不变性验证工具，将智能体生成GPU内核的BI通过率从67.6%提升至91.9%。 Large language model (LLM) serving systems dynamically batch user requests for GPU execution, so the same request may be processed alongside different requests across runs. If the GPU kernels lack batch invariance (BI), this changing batch context can alter the numerical output for an unchanged input, undermining reproducibility. Existing kernel generation agents focus on correctness and efficiency but \emph{overlook BI}. We find 19 confirmed BI violations among 83 batch-applicable released artifacts. To address this limitation, we propose \tool, which combines contract-guided static dependency analysis with dynamic validation of bitwise consistency across batch contexts. \tool is designed as a plug-in component for general kernel agents, allowing their original optimization capabilities to be reused while adding BI enforcement. We integrate it as successive acceptance gates in the optimization loop, rejecting structurally risky or dynamically non-invariant candidates before performance benchmarking and returning feedback to the agent. Experiments across three agent frameworks under baseline and BI-aware generation on real world LLM serving tasks show that \tool improves the BI pass rate from 67.6\% to 91.9\% while retaining 91.8\% of the baseline geometric mean speedup. These results demonstrate that \tool can be incorporated into kernel optimization by agents as an additional reliability objective alongside correctness and speed.
paragraphs.zh: 提出批处理不变性验证工具，将智能体生成GPU内核的BI通过率从67.6%提升至91.9%。大语言模型（LLM）服务系统会动态地将用户请求批量组合后在GPU上执行，因此同一请求在不同运行中可能与不同的请求一起被处理。 如果GPU内核缺乏批处理不变性（BI），这种不断变化的批量上下文可能改变同一输入的数值输出，从而破坏可复现性。 现有的内核生成智能体关注正确性和效率，但\emph{忽视了BI}。 我们在83个适用于批处理的已发布产物中发现19个经确认的BI违规。 为解决这一局限，我们提出\tool，它将契约引导的静态依赖分析与跨批量上下文的按位一致性动态验证相结合。\tool被设计为通用内核智能体的插件式组件，可复用其原有的优化能力，同时增加BI强制保障。 我们将其作为优化循环中的逐级验收门控，在性能基准测试之前拒绝结构上有风险或动态非不变的候选内核，并向智能体返回反馈。 在真实世界LLM服务任务上，跨三个智能体框架在基线生成与BI感知生成下的实验表明，\tool将BI通过率从67.6\%提升至91.9\%，同时保留了基线几何平均加速比的91.8\%。 这些结果表明，\tool可以作为智能体内核优化中除正确性和速度之外的额外可靠性目标被纳入。
